question: Which .NET Framework versions are supported by Fern-generated SDKs for Unity development?
ground_truth: Fern-generated .NET SDKs support .NET Framework versions 4.6.2, 4.7, 4.7.1, 4.7.2, 4.8, and 4.8.1 for Unity development. Unity typically uses either .NET Standard 2.1 (recommended for cross-platform plugins) or .NET Framework 4.x (Unity's "4.x equivalent" profile) as the API compatibility level.
